reason: Audit implementation against the exact pre-change contracts and approved decisions.
Verify OpenAPI/handler/generated compatibility, filter matrix, cursor privacy, auth/CSRF and stable errors.
Verify v6/v7/Down migration safety, matching indexes, atomic unread markers, monotonic watermark and derived counts.
Check edge, persistence, concurrency, privacy and restart evidence at the narrowest layer.
Ensure no duplicate server state, optimistic SMS outcome or SSE-authored unread state.
Reject handwritten public payload copies, unsafe casts and generated schema drift.
Verify observable desktop/mobile behavior, accessibility, overflow, E2E and no-HIL fixtures.
Check synthetic communication data and prevent numbers, screenshots, logs or private evidence entering public artifacts.
Audit end-to-end boundary ownership and race-safe round trips rather than layer-local success only.
